Pick a diagram by picture

Point at what you like and say the words under it. Mix freely: a kind, a page layout and a look, in Light or Dark. Every picture here is the same system, AI-powered Kubernetes incident response, drawn from one model. Nothing named means Clear, the house standard.

1 Kind: what sort of picture

Most diagrams are a Map. Pick Sequence for one request in time order.

2 Layout: the page around it (optional)

For a page, an explainer, a blog post or a wiki page built around a Map. Explainer pages explain, Blog pages argue a point, Wiki pages let people look things up. Shown in Clear.

3 Look

Clear is the default. Any Map, Sequence or page can be drawn in any of these.

4 Mix them

A layout in a look, or a drawing in a look. Our picks first; pick a layout, a look or both to see every mix.

Every picture is drawn by node diagrams/gallery.js from the example model, in Light and in Dark. Every page built from these (and the style picker and preview) has the same Light / Dark / Auto toggle; it switches the whole page with its drawings and is remembered per page.
